research_question: Record the deviation of the actual CPCD judge from the preregistered GPT-5.2 judge, so the frozen audit chain matches the executed pipeline.

deviation.scope: All four judged arms (deepseek_v4_pro, deepseek_v4_flash, qwen_3_6_27b, qwen_3_6_27b_siliconflow) were scored by the same proxy judge endpoint, so within-table pre/post comparison remains valid.
deviation.reporting_rule: CPCD scores under this proxy judge are internal pre/post quality scores. They must never be presented as CPCD-Bench paper (GPT-5.2-judged) leaderboard results or ranked against paper-reported numbers.
notes: The preregistered GPT-5.2 judge was not executed for these arms; no GPT-5.2 judgements exist in outputs/.
Blindness is preserved: the judge prompt contains only the anonymous blind_id, never the model identity.
deepseek_v4_pro has 12/159 generations with finish_reason=length (TCR 8, SR 3, MR 1) that were judged as stored; its scores are therefore a conservative lower bound and do not favor the DeepSeek arm.
The micro-finetune post-test must reuse this same proxy judge endpoint, temperature=0, non-thinking mode, and the same blind_id scheme to keep the pre/post delta meaningful.
